'''Blackie''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Blackie recorded a monologue, in which he discussed [[Rufus Trammel]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who was leaving the Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system]]. He speculated that Trammel's departure would bring about changes in the Cularin system and claimed to have heard that Trammel's organization acted as a front for the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Phylus Mon]].

==Personality and traits==
Blackie was street-smart and liked to carry large [[Blaster/Legends|guns]] and large [[Knife/Legends|knives]]. He was not keen on grooming himself or taking a shower.
